All 14 harvest_pool_live URLs were opened directly (curl, not WebFetch) and checked for 余江/鹰潭/西气东输二线/西二线: none of the 14 mentions Yujiang or Yingtan -- they cover Tarim/Xinjiang (dbnyb), a Henan provincial pipeline table (henb xls), Hubei Zhugang-Xiangfan-Shiyan (syrb), Guangxi Guangzhou-Nanning (archive.org gov.cn capture), and general WEP overviews (paper.ce.cn, hnlt, scmp, downstreamtoday) -- none touch Jiangxi's Yujiang/Yingtan corridor at all. The zgbk.com encyclopedia entry (https://www.zgbk.com/ecph/words?SiteID=1&ID=398550) is a SOFT-DEAD entry page ('您访问的条目路径已失效' -- the entry path has expired), confirmed by direct curl+read, not a fabricated quote. The q.stock.sohu.com PDF URL now redirects to a generic Sohu stock-quote JS landing page (no PDF content reachable). The MEE 2016 East-section completion letter (https://www.mee.gov.cn/gkml/sthjbgw/spwj1/201612/t20161222_369429.htm), which exhaustively names exactly five East-section branches (per P4946/P4944's shards, verbatim-quoted), does NOT include 余江-鹰潭/鹰潭支线 among them.
